tasks.label: Start Demo
tasks.detail: Ctrl+Shift+B - runs the records API (:8099) and the Blazor front end (:8080)
tasks.command: fuser -k 8080/tcp 8099/tcp >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; $HOME/.dotnet-local/dotnet run --no-build --project src/Records.Api & API_PID=$!; $HOME/.dotnet-local/dotnet run --no-build --project src/Records.Web & WEB_PID=$!; trap 'kill $API_PID $WEB_PID 2>/dev/null' EXIT INT TERM; wait

tasks.label: Run Web
tasks.detail: Blazor Server front end and agent on :8080

tasks.label: Stop Demo
tasks.command: pkill -f Records.Api || true; pkill -f Records.Web || true; echo 'demo stopped'

tasks.label: Build
tasks.command: $HOME/.dotnet-local/dotnet restore src/Records.Api/Records.Api.csproj --disable-parallel && $HOME/.dotnet-local/dotnet restore src/Records.Web/Records.Web.csproj --disable-parallel && $HOME/.dotnet-local/dotnet build src/Records.Api/Records.Api.csproj --no-restore -m:1 -p:UseSharedCompilation=false && $HOME/.dotnet-local/dotnet build src/Records.Web/Records.Web.csproj --no-restore -m:1 -p:UseSharedCompilation=false -p:BuildInParallel=false
